verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in AI assistant inside Adyen Risk Management that users can delegate tasks to. The ML risk-scoring engine is automated decisioning, not an assistant. The MCP server only lets users work through their own external LLM client, so it is an adjacent integration rather than an in-product assistant and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
